title: Transition W9: integrate runtime shadow-mode discovery traces (Phase 2)
description:
Workstream W9 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, Phase 2 (section
12.2): docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of runtime shadow-mode observation for discovery.
No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
Run discovery in shadow mode on real turns, after assembleContext and before
renderContextMessage (the seam verified at orchestrator.ts:561 and :576), and
record, without altering DM input:

- explicit and derived signals;
- candidates and every retrieval route;
- relationship traversals;
- campaign-rule and ruling matches obtained through the eshyra-jhpt read seam;
- dedup decisions;
- priority band and retained candidates;
- rejected candidates, each with its reason;
- the proposed context packet;
- capability preflight results.

Shadow evidence attaches to the existing accepted-turn trace authority
(memory/turnTrace.ts TurnTraceRecord, written at orchestrator.ts:817) or returns
through that existing trace seam.

NON-GOALS AND PROHIBITIONS
- The DM sees exactly what it sees today. No packet is injected; changing DM
  input is W10.
- No competing readiness database, second campaign-rule store, or second finding
  registry (ADR 0017 section 8; ADR 0020 audit-architecture restraint).
- No discovery-owned campaign-rule persistence, ruling schema, or lifecycle;
  those stay with eshyra-jhpt.
- No claim of universal discovery completeness and no aggregate coverage figure.
  Measurements stay independent per probe and per stage.
- Presence of material in a shadow packet is never reported as evidence that the
  model used it.

BASELINE VALIDITY (design section 9.6)
Shadow evidence gathered before the applicable baseline repairs is diagnostic
only and may not be called a baseline. Specifically: no stat-block probe
evidence before B1 (eshyra-l3e5); no adventure-context evidence (P9) before B2
(eshyra-seoh); no deterministic-agreement measurement (M11) before B3
(eshyra-6vpw); no capability-agreement evidence (P8) before B5 (eshyra-uiax);
and table:starting-wealth-by-class is never treated as SRD authority at any time
(B4, eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1).

DEPENDENCIES
W8 accepted (Phase 1 exit criteria met), plus the baseline repairs applicable to
the probes being shadowed: eshyra-l3e5 (W1), eshyra-seoh (W2), eshyra-6vpw (W3),
eshyra-uiax (W5). Not parallel-safe with its own prerequisites.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Shadow traces for the probe corpus over real turns, attached to the existing
TurnTraceRecord seam; a test proving DM input is byte-identical with and without
shadow discovery enabled; M1-M11 derivable from the recorded trace without
re-running discovery.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Shadow traces exist for the probe corpus over real turns; every section-13
measurement through M11 is derivable from the trace; no new durable store was
introduced; each trace records which blockers were repaired at capture time so a
pre-repair capture can never be mistaken for a baseline.

MATERIAL CHANGE: yes. It adds a runtime observation point in the turn pipeline,
without changing what the DM receives.
acceptance_criteria:
Discovery runs after assembleContext and before renderContextMessage on real
turns. DM input is unchanged: a test proves the rendered context message is
identical with shadow discovery enabled and disabled. Shadow evidence attaches
to the existing accepted-turn trace authority (memory/turnTrace.ts
TurnTraceRecord) or returns through that existing trace seam; no competing
readiness store, campaign-rule store, or finding registry is created. Both
retained and rejected candidates are recorded with every retrieval route and
every rejection reason, and dedup preserves all routes. Campaign rules and
rulings come only from the eshyra-jhpt read seam. Each capture records which
baseline repairs were in place, and shadow evidence gathered before the
applicable repairs is labelled diagnostic-only and is never reported as a valid
baseline: no stat-block evidence before eshyra-l3e5, no P9 adventure-context
evidence before eshyra-seoh, no M11 deterministic-agreement measurement before
eshyra-6vpw, no P8 capability-agreement evidence before eshyra-uiax, and
table:starting-wealth-by-class never surfaces as SRD authority. M1-M11 are
derivable from the trace without re-running discovery, are reported
independently per probe, and are never aggregated into a coverage, readiness, or
completeness score. Packet presence is never reported as evidence that the model
used the material.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
